question: Where can I get a list of battery storage (BESS) installations in operation in Australia, with location, power (MW), energy (MWh), operator and commissioning date?

answer.summary: No single official national list exists. For the NEM (QLD, NSW/ACT, VIC, SA, TAS) AEMO's quarterly NEM Generation Information xlsx lists each battery unit with status, MW AC, MWh and owner (58 units across 'In Service' and 'In Commissioning', Oct 2026); NEMWEB MMS tables add registered participant, station address and registration dates. Neither gives coordinates and commissioning dates are mostly blank. For WA's WEM, AEMO's daily facilities CSV gives only code, participant and System Size (combined import and export rating). Open Electricity (non-official, CC BY-NC) covers NEM+WEM with coordinates, MW, MWh, owner and start date. NT/off-grid not verified.
main_caveats: Registration is not operation: MMS START_DATE and 'COMMISSIONED' mark registration (often the 2024 IESS re-registration); GI 'In Service' needs AEMO sign-off after commissioning tests.
GI status can lag: Waratah Super Battery (WTAHB1) is 'Committed' in the Oct 2026 release while MMS SCADA shows it discharging up to 556.8 MW in Oct 2026.
WEM 'System Size' adds withdrawal to export capacity: KWINANA_ESR1 System Size 200 vs ~100 MW peak in Oct 2026 SCADA; use a documented export rating. SCADA shows observed output only.
GI and MMS give MW and MWh per generating unit (DUID row); a site or hybrid spans several rows and 'Max Site Capacity (AC)' caps the site.
Official files name owner, MSATS custodian or registered participant, not an operator; they can differ (MREHA3: owner Equis SPV, participant SEC Energy).
Open Electricity is non-official, CC BY-NC 4.0 and excludes AI training/grounding from its standard licence; its MW, MWh and dates can differ from AEMO.
answer.confidence_reason: NEM and WEM official files were downloaded and cross-checked; NT/off-grid, AER and DCCEEW pages could not be opened (403/timeouts) and Overpass was unavailable.

attributes.note: NEM official: MMS station address/locality; GA points (July 2024 fleet); GI only region. WEM: none official. Coordinates NEM+WEM: Open Electricity (non-official).
attributes.gap_note: Official coordinates not published for the current NEM or WEM fleet (GI, MMS, WEM CSV checked); NT/off-grid documents returned HTTP 403 and remain unchecked.

attributes.note: NEM: MW AC per unit (GI) and registered/max MW (MMS). WEM: System Size counts export plus withdrawal; SCADA gives actual MW.
attributes.gap_note: WEM discharge MW not published as such (System Size only); off-grid systems (NT, Horizon Power, NWIS) not verified (HTTP 403 / no list).

attributes.note: NEM: nameplate MWh per unit (GI) and MAXSTORAGECAPACITY (MMS), disagreeing for 10 units. WEM: only non-official per unit; WATC gives an aggregate.
attributes.gap_note: Official per-installation MWh not published for the WEM (facilities CSV, CRC files, ESM Rules checked; WEM ESOO 403); off-grid not verified.

attributes.note: Official: GI Site Owner and MSATS Custodian, MMS registered participant name, WEM Market Participant. No field labelled operator.
attributes.gap_note: Operator as such not published by AEMO (GI definitions, MMS, WEM CSV checked); OSM 'operator' tag only per mapped element; off-grid not verified.

attributes.note: GI FCUD in 14/58 rows (19/24 in Jul 2024 release) and Change Log status dates; MMS dates are registration. Open Electricity commencement_date for all.
attributes.gap_note: No official in-service date field for the WEM (facilities CSV) or for most NEM units; WA pages give text dates; off-grid not verified.

sources.name: NEM Generation Information (October 2026 release) with KCI datafile
sources.license: AEMO copyright; use per AEMO website copyright permissions
sources.summary: Official quarterly xlsx of every NEM unit with status, MW AC, MWh, owner and DUID; 58 battery rows In Service/In Commissioning (54 sites) in the Oct 2026 release.
sources.coverage_note: NEM only; location only as NEM region; commissioning date mostly blank (Change Log gives status-change release dates).

problems: Landing page and file URL without ?rev= return HTTP 403 (Cloudflare challenge) to automated clients.

example.example_request: curl -sL -o gi.xlsx 'https://www.aemo.com.au/-/media/files/electricity/nem/planning_and_forecasting/generation_information/2026/nem-generation-information-oct-2026.xlsx?rev=e4625386b864409786cd79986dd0ac04&sc_lang=en'  # sheet 'Generator Information', header row 4; Technology Type='Battery Storage'; Commitment Status in ('In Service','In Commissioning')

if_unstructured.summary: Official structured data cover the NEM (no coordinates, few commissioning dates) and WA's SWIS (no MWh, location or dates). Missing pieces come from AEMO's release archive and Change Log and from WA government pages and reports; NT/off-grid documents could not be opened.

local_terms.meaning: AEMO's quarterly xlsx of existing and proposed NEM generating/storage units; filter Technology Type 'Battery Storage'.
Unit code that joins GI, MMS tables, SCADA and Open Electricity.
MMS DISPATCHTYPE for batteries registered under the IESS rules (from mid-2024).
WEM term for storage; battery facility codes contain '_ESR' (or '_BESS').
WEM facility capacity in MW; for storage it adds withdrawal to sent-out capacity.
GI field: date units are expected to become operationally available after NER 5.7.3 tests.
GI statuses: hold point >=30% capacity passed / commissioning signed off by AEMO.
Battery energy storage system; common in AEMO site names (e.g. 'Orana BESS').
